questions: During the episode, did you have any shortness of breath or chest pain?
Do you have any leg swelling or pain (especially one-sided) or recent long travel/immobility?
Did you have any fainting or loss of consciousness during the episode?
**During the episode, did you have a new irregular heartbeat or racing heart sensation (palpitations)?**
Did this shortness of breath start suddenly (within seconds to minutes), or did it build up gradually?
During the episode, did you have any chest pain or pain that got worse when you took a deep breath (pleuritic pain)?
During the episode, did you have any wheezing or noisy breathing/stridor (high-pitched sound) when you inhaled or exhaled?
During the episode, what was your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) if you measured it, or did you notice blue lips/fingertips?
When you had the near-fainting/shortness of breath, what was your heart rate (or did you measure your pulse), and was it very fast compared with your usual?
Did you have any coughing up blood (hemoptysis) during or after the episode?
